summary: EDENOR S.A., an Argentine electric utility, filed a Form 6-K announcing early results of a debt tender offer for its 9.75% Senior Notes due 2030. The company increased the tender cap from $150M to $175M in aggregate principal amount, accepting $175M of the $270.4M tendered at a consideration of $1,020 per note (a premium over par). This is a routine liability management transaction, not a special situation, as it involves the issuer repurchasing its own outstanding debt for cash without equity implications or corporate control changes.
